info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account UsageReport API

params.name: dataByDays
params.description: Usage Report of last 7 days including the present day.

params.name: dataByWeeks
params.description: Usage Report of last 5 weeks including present week.

params.name: dataByMonths
params.description: Usage Report of last 4 Months including the current month.

params.name: dataByQuarters
params.description: Usage Report of last 3 quarters including current quarter.

params.name: divisionId
params.description: Division id of which usage report Required

params.name: productId
params.description: ProductId if which usage report required

items.docs:
Return usage report for the provided parameters.  
The parameters are optional, and you may include either of them to customize the query.If no parameters are passed, then usage report by months is returned.
